'''Maraffa sap''' was a type of [[sap/Legends|sap]], [[color/Legends|orange]] in color, harvested from the [[Maraffa]] tree from the planet [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].<ref name="FP" /> It was used in the creation of the [[pitted ka-olive pie]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maraffa sap was first mentioned in the article "[[Fair Prey]]"<ref name="FP" /> and made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="TOR:PfaD" />
